tokens.sent: How about spending the money on building more cycle lanes?
I’d like to see a graffiti wall and a skateboard park for a start and maybe if there is enough money, we can have a climbing wall, too.
Why don’t we use the money to turn some of these empty shops into an arts centre?
We could also have a music studio where local bands can record music cheaply.

How about a big billboard at the entrance to the town that reads, ‘TEEN WARNING – there’s nothing to do here!’
This probably sounds like a boring idea, but can’t we use some of the money to buy more litter bins?
